newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin seeks extra time for 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Serfin seeks extra time for 1996 results.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Serfin, owner of Mexico's third largest bank, is seeking a two-week extension of the deadline for reporting 1996 financial results to March 15, spokesman Roberto Aguirre said on Monday.
He declined to give a reason.

He had previously said the results would be issued in late February, saying that in the meantime Serfin was continuing talks on the sale of a 19.9 percent stake with two potential partners -- London-based HSBC Holdings Plc and an unnamed U.S. bank.
Some banking analysts expect a sale and the 1996 results to be announced at the same time, but Aguirre was unable to give any information on the status of the sale negotiations.
Serfin officials, speaking on condition of anonymity, said they were suprised the sale had not yet been announced, adding that management was being "very hermetic" on the issue.
